mapper.update: UPDATE message_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, processing_started_at = #{now}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_retry_at <= #{now}
UPDATE message_outbox SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{now}, processing_started_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}

UPDATE message_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, next_retry_at = #{now}, processing_started_at = NULL, last_error = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'Publisher confirm timed out and all attempts were exhausted' ELSE 'Publisher confirm timed out; recovered by outbox relay' END WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_started_at <= #{deadline}
